title: 第11章 求财第12章 怎么有人
slug: 道爷斗法累了西幻炸个鱼怎么了
lines: 去外界兜售秘境的材料吗？风险太大了光是来路问题便很难解决。
作为一个散修，偶尔拿出些灵草销售自然是无妨，若是大量出手，容易引起其他商行的调查和打压，甚至可能会被当做是赃物，被一些销售行当拒之门外。
去一些三不管地带或者魔教的地盘倒是不会过多的盘查，本就是把脸一蒙原地从正道转职魔修的地方，谁管你这东西哪里来的，可无序的作用也是双面的，在这种地方安全保障全看自身本领，有命卖货不一定有命收摊，至少在筑基之前，这条道路不被陈昭考虑。
开玩笑，炼气期的小修遇上事了跑都跑不脱，说不定吃了个莫名AOE就身死道消了，起码得攒上几张筑基期的传送符保障安全再说。
至于说穿梭，陈昭目前只能确定，在身体有所损伤时进行穿梭会自动进行治疗，被人一刀砍死的时候会不会触发穿梭把自己复活，陈昭是不清楚的，也不敢去赌啊！
若是没触发那不是完了，只有当万策尽的时候才能去尝试这条路子吧。
唉，这就是没有自带金手指的坏处了，碰上事情没个解说的，全要自己去一点点尝试。
现在面对这红色法宝，到底啥功能也不知道，和给甲方系统写拓展程序似的，到底开放了哪些api接口，一问三不知，挨个猜着试过去吧。
玄清界的路子走不通了，那便想想秘境的路子吧，陈昭有预感，这秘境中的灵气资源如此丰富，必定有高品质的灵矿存在，只是秘境中的灵矿究竟是什么样子，目前还不可知。
先前在那炼金术师的魔法店中也未见到过灵石类似物，总不能拿着灵石到处问人见没见过相似的吧？这个世界的人还大概率无法感知到灵气，在他们眼里可能陈昭就是个拿着破石头到处问人的神经病吧。
若是这方世界之中也有隐藏的修士，四处询问岂不是暴露了自身？当前实力低微，陈昭不得不谨慎！
要是能有个系统蹦出来告诉自己这片天地其实是一个并非玄清界的另一方完整世界，整个世界只有陈昭一个修仙的修士，随便怎么练，随便怎么嚣张就好了。
摇了摇头，把不切实际的幻想甩出脑袋，陈昭站起身来，活动了下筋骨。
好像也已经过了先前和那炼金术师的约定时间，也是时候去找那炼金术师要钱了。
揣摩着手上的戒指，陈昭回忆着当初第一次见面的场景。
如今手持四个储物袋，陈昭对于收纳方面的需求也并没有那么急迫，这戒指还也就还了。
在玄清界不敢用那家族标记的储物袋不代表在秘境之中不敢用，即便有隐藏的修士，是这储物袋原主家族修士的概率那也是微乎其微，这倒不用那么紧张的神经兮兮。
这番前去和炼金术师会面，收钱是一方面，另一方面也是为了再采购些药材。
如今得了好心人送的一本《简明炼体修士实用药草与锻体材料图鉴》，陈昭也是能认出些供体修使用的药材了。
即便秘境之中的药材和玄清界的版本存在差异，但只要药力性质差不多，那便都可使用。
像先前陈昭收买到的那些灵气大药便是这番，尽管药材长的十分抽象，一个个不是人脸萝卜就是张着利齿的大嘴花，和玄清界那些亭亭玉立一看就带着一股子仙气的灵草完全没法比，但蕴含的灵气却一模一样，甚至灵气密度要更加浓郁的多。
丑是丑了点，你就说能不能用吧！
无论是出于对实力的追求还是为了填补这红色宝石对气血的需求，这个“体”
陈昭是非练不可了。
依照简明体修图鉴上的说法，体修的境界划分大致和灵修一样，分为锻体境，通脉境，淬骨境，元罡境等，对应炼气、筑基、金丹、元婴。
每一境界分入门、小成、半步大成、大成。
锻体境作为体修的入门境界，算是贯彻了人人有功练这一精神，仅需修炼外功，锤炼身体，熬打筋骨，在辅以药浴淬身，强化肉体。
练至大成，便是力达千斤，皮肉坚韧如牛革，徒手即可碎岩。
只要肯吃苦，便可提高，是个毫无门槛的境界，莫说是许多修士，凡人武夫里修得锻体境小成的也是一抓一大把，不过因为天赋受限难得大成而已。
大概是因为只是初阶阶段，这药浴的材料也非常简单，除去一些气血充沛的草药外，比较关键的大药只有三种，烈阳草、铁骨藤、赤血参，那年长修士储物袋中的体修药材已收集了三分之一，包括一份够修炼到大成的铁骨藤。
这铁骨藤常见于陡峭山崖悬臂之上，采摘十分困难，天门宗每次组织杂役弟子上山采摘，失足坠崖身亡者十之七八，不过产量倒也不低，年长修士这炼气期弟子也能购买到这些量。
如今倒是便宜了陈昭。
烈阳草、赤血参，一听便是阳属性大爆发的材料，这也不奇怪，体修本就是以气血充沛着称，强化体魄自然是用得到这些阳气旺盛的材料，后期往深了修炼，还需要许多火属性妖兽的骨血来淬体呢！
这章没有结束，请点击下一页继续阅读！
当然，因为气血旺盛，体修普遍脾气暴躁，和先前那头尖尖魔修门派一样容易招惹是非，所以体修还需修行心法，静心巩固修为，方可再进一步。
陈昭现在的主力灵根为上品火灵根，对这些阳气旺盛的药材十分敏感，相比接下来寻找替代药材会便利许多吧。
将旅店的房间布置了一下，以防自己不在的时候有人闯入，这间房间的位置陈昭十分满意，一开窗便能接触到初升太阳。
虽然如今主脉已扩充到极限，可陈昭还是喜好引入些紫气来继续熬打自己的经脉，顺便看看能不能扩充些支脉。
陈昭下楼本想问旅店老板再续订几个月的房间，却被为难的告知这间面朝初阳的房间已被预定，即便陈昭加钱也难出让。
不过旅馆老板也愿意为陈昭进行沟通，毕竟陈昭虽然深居简出，但平时给钱确实很阔绰。
那位预定房间的客人晚上便会到达旅店，届时陈昭可亲自和其沟通。
也并非一定要这房间不可，对陈昭来说，自然是随处都可练功的，只是有个习惯的固定据点更加隐秘一些而已，若是那客人不同意，陈昭换家面向太阳的旅店便是。
换个地方住而已，多大点事，大不了上山去和动物朋友当室友，堂堂修士自可以地为床以天为被，朝饮露水，夜食野兽，只是没必要而已，修仙修仙，自是修的一个念头通达，让自己过得舒服一些也是念头通达的一方面嘛。
若是因为这点小事便暴起杀人，砍了老板砍客人，屠了旅店屠城镇，那也有些太小鸡肚肠了，倒像是个精神病，又不是什么杀父夺妻之仇，倘若就这点气量，那还修什么仙，要是遇上困难非得气出些心魔来。

content_en:
Going to the outside world to sell secret realm materials? The risk is too great and it is difficult to solve the problem of origin alone.
As a casual cultivator, it is okay to occasionally take out some spiritual herbs for sale. If he sells them in large quantities, it will easily lead to investigation and suppression by other firms. He may even be regarded as stolen goods and be rejected by some sales firms.
You won’t do too much checking when you go to some Sanzang zones or demon sect sites. This is a place where you switch from the righteous path to a demon cultivator with your face covered. Who cares where you got this thing from, but the role of disorder is also two-sided. In such a place, safety and security all depends on your own ability. If you have a life to sell goods, you may not have a life to close the stall. At least before the foundation is established, this path is not considered by Chen Zhao.
Just kidding, Xiaoxiu in the Qi Refining Stage can't run away if something happens to him. He might die after eating an inexplicable AOE. At least he has to save a few teleportation talismans from the Foundation Establishment Stage to ensure safety.
As for the shuttle, Chen Zhao can currently only confirm that when the body is injured, the shuttle will automatically heal him. If he is hacked to death by someone, the shuttle will trigger the shuttle to resurrect him. Chen Zhao doesn't know, and he doesn't dare to gamble!
If it doesn't trigger, it's not the end. You can only try this path when all options are exhausted.
Alas, this is the disadvantage of not bringing your own cheats. If you encounter something without an explanation, you have to try it yourself.
Now facing this red magic weapon, I don’t know what its functions are. It’s like writing an extension program for Party A’s system. I don’t know which API interfaces are open. I don’t know if I ask three questions. Let’s try them one by one.
The path to the Xuanqing Realm is dead, so let’s think about the path to the secret realm. Chen Zhao has a hunch that the spiritual energy resources in this secret realm are so rich, there must be high-quality spiritual minerals, but what the spiritual minerals in the secret realm look like is currently unknown.
I had never seen anything similar to the spirit stone in the alchemist's magic shop before, so I couldn't take the spirit stone around and ask people if they had seen anything similar, right? There is a high probability that people in this world cannot sense spiritual energy. In their eyes, Chen Zhao may be just a lunatic who goes around asking people with broken stones.
If there are hidden monks in this world, wouldn't asking around expose oneself? With his current weak strength, Chen Zhao has to be cautious!
It would be great if a system could pop up and tell him that this world is actually a complete world on the other side of the world that is not the Xuanqing world. There is only Chen Zhao, a monk who cultivates immortality, and he can practice however he wants and be as arrogant as he wants.
Shaking his head to get rid of unrealistic fantasies, Chen Zhao stood up and stretched his muscles.
It seemed that the time agreed with the alchemist had passed, and it was time to go to the alchemist to ask for money.
Looking at the ring on his hand, Chen Zhao recalled the scene of their first meeting.
Now holding four storage bags, Chen Zhao's need for storage is not that urgent, so he can just return the ring.
Just because you don't dare to use the storage bag with the family mark in the Xuanqing world doesn't mean you don't dare to use it in the secret realm. Even if there are hidden monks, the probability of being a monk from the family that originally owned the storage bag is very slim, so you don't need to be so nervous.
This time I went to meet the alchemist not only to collect money, but also to purchase some more medicinal materials.
Now that a kind-hearted person had given him a copy of "A Concise Illustrated Book of Practical Herbs and Body Training Materials for Body Refining Cultivators", Chen Zhao could also recognize some of the medicinal materials used for body training.
Even if there are differences between the medicinal materials in the secret realm and the versions in the Xuanqing realm, as long as the medicinal properties are similar, they can all be used.
These are the great spiritual medicines that Chen Zhao purchased earlier. Although the medicinal materials are very abstract, and each one is either a radish with a human face or a big-mouthed flower with sharp teeth. It is completely incomparable with the slim spiritual herbs in the Xuanqing world that carry a fairy aura at first glance, but the spiritual energy contained is exactly the same, and even the density of the spiritual energy is much richer.
It's a bit ugly, just tell me if it can be used!
Whether it is for the pursuit of strength or to fill the red gem's need for blood, this "body"
Chen Zhao must practice.
According to the concise illustration of physical cultivation, the realms of physical cultivation are roughly the same as those of spiritual cultivation, which are divided into body forging realm, channel channeling realm, bone tempering realm, Yuangang realm, etc., corresponding to Qi refining, foundation building, golden elixir, and Yuanying realm.
Each state is divided into entry level, small level level, half-step level level, and full level level.
As the introductory realm of physical cultivation, the physical training realm implements the spirit that everyone has the right to practice martial arts. It only requires practicing external martial arts, tempering the body, and stretching the muscles and bones, supplemented by medicinal baths to temper the body and strengthen the body.
When you practice to a great level, you will be able to reach a thousand catties of strength, your skin and flesh will be as tough as cow leather, and you can break rocks with your bare hands.
As long as you are willing to endure hardships, you can improve. It is a realm without any threshold. Not to mention many monks, there are also a lot of mortal warriors who have achieved a small level of body training, but due to limited talents, it is difficult to achieve great success.
Probably because it was only the initial stage, the materials for this medicinal bath were also very simple. Apart from some herbs that were full of vitality and blood, there were only three key herbs, Agni Grass, Iron Bone Vine, and Red Blood Ginseng. That year, one-third of the body-building medicinal materials in the elder monk's storage bag had been collected, including a portion of Iron Bone Vine that was enough for cultivation to a great level.
This iron-bone vine is often found on the cantilevers of steep mountain cliffs, and it is very difficult to pick. Every time the Tianmen Sect organizes handyman disciples to go up the mountain to pick, 70% of them will slip and fall off the cliff and die. However, the output is not low, and the older monks and disciples in the Qi refining period can also buy these quantities.
Chen Zhao is now much cheaper.
Sun grass and red blood ginseng are materials that can explode the yang attribute. This is not surprising. Physical cultivation is known for its abundant qi and blood. To strengthen the body, these materials with strong yang energy are naturally used. In the later stage, as the cultivation progresses, the bones and blood of many fire attribute monsters will be needed to temper the body!
This chapter is not over, please click on the next page to continue reading!
Of course, because of the strong Qi and blood, the body cultivators generally have bad tempers and are as prone to trouble as the sharp-headed demon cultivator sect before. Therefore, the body cultivators still need to practice their mental methods and meditate to consolidate their cultivation before they can go any further.
Chen Zhao's current main spiritual root is the high-grade fire spiritual root, which is very sensitive to these medicinal materials with strong yang energy. It will be much more convenient than searching for alternative medicinal materials next time.
Chen Zhao arranged the hotel room to prevent anyone from breaking in when he was away. Chen Zhao was very satisfied with the location of the room. He could touch the rising sun as soon as he opened the window.
Although the main meridians have now been expanded to the limit, Chen Zhao still likes to introduce some purple energy to continue to beat his meridians and see if he can expand some branch meridians.
Chen Zhao went downstairs and wanted to ask the hotel owner to renew the room for a few more months, but was embarrassed to be told that the room facing Chuyang had been reserved, and it would be difficult to sell it even if Chen Zhao added money.
However, the hotel owner is also willing to communicate with Chen Zhao. After all, although Chen Zhao lives in seclusion, he usually pays quite generously.
The guest who booked the room will arrive at the hotel in the evening, and Chen Zhao can communicate with him personally.
It doesn’t have to be this room. For Chen Zhao, he can practice anywhere, but he just has a habit of having a fixed base that is more secretive. If the guest doesn’t agree, Chen Zhao will change to a hotel facing the sun.
It's just a matter of changing a place to live. It's not a big deal. The worst it can do is go up the mountain and be roommates with animal friends. A dignified monk can use the sky as his bed and the quilt, drink dew in the morning and eat wild animals at night. It's just not necessary. Cultivation of immortals is a clear idea of ​​cultivation. Making oneself more comfortable is also an aspect of the clear mind.
If he went on a killing rampage because of such a trivial matter, beheading the boss and customers, slaughtering hotels and towns, that would be a bit too chicken-hearted. It would be more like a mental illness, and it is not a revenge for killing his father and taking his wife. If he only has this kind of courage, he would not be an immortal. If he encounters difficulties, he will have to vent his inner demons.
